test_title: PYST 30: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 26th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bdfc67eade5c1ffa605061580e074198e982a1e87977bed1d41eb7d1aa71b86f.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

1) First position figure shifted to the last position.

2) Second position figure shifted to the first position.

3) Third position figure shifted to the second position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37f88b62d2b14832060fe98f3a49a9cba072eefd51a9a97527dc448beea67170.png] 

Final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0265c41e0a68016fc5ce7c433cbd5e5fedecd15c53d70f97a80f880d4011350.png] 

Hence, **‘option 3’ **is the correct answer.
